title: SharePoint: Governance Reviews Dashboard for site owners
summary: Hold: the mixed licensing classification implies a dashboard entitlement that Microsoft has not documented; the published lifecycle-policy prerequisites do not establish it. The roadmap facts and existing policy navigation are supported, but the assertion that the dashboard introduces no new data access is unverified.
